charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day, but on day 15 it was at coffee_table_l1 at 12:22. It was also at nightstand_b1 at 22:35. The charger moves: coffee_table_l1 in the morning (09:00-10:00) and mid-day (12:00-13:00), desk_o1 in the afternoon (14:00-17:00), and nightstand_b1 at night (22:00+). Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day queries and nightstand_b1 for late night.

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for early afternoon, but on day 15 it was at dining_table_d1 at 20:24. The bottle is at coffee_table_l1 in the morning (08:00-10:00) and early afternoon (13:00-14:00), desk_o1 in the late afternoon (14:00-17:00), and dining_table_d1 in the evening (20:00+). Check dining_table_d1 for evening queries.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for all daytime, which held on day 14. No new errors today. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for daytime queries (08:00-18:00).

book_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning, which held on day 14. No new errors today. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for morning queries.

glass_tomas: No new errors today; keep previous pattern of dining_table_d1 for early evening and nightstand_b1 for very late night.
